_about: Each circle's grammar line for the circle overview, with the target language between ** for bold (Dan, 2026-11-19; src/lib/note-text.js). Unit id to text; import.mjs puts it in place of the workbook's plain grammar_point. One line each, kept in step with the workbook and the full note.

points.U01: **være** for who you are: **jeg er**, **du er**, **han er**; **en** or **et** for a; **nei**, **ikke**
points.U02: The is a suffix: **mann → mannen**, **hus → huset**; **han** and **hun**; a job takes no article: **han er lege**
points.U03: Set phrases; **takk**; **vær så snill** for please, **vær så god** for here you are; **Hvordan går det?** **Bra**
points.U04: Present is one form: **spiser**, **drikker**; **liker** for liking: **jeg liker kaffe**
points.U06: Plurals add **-er**: **hund → hunder**; some et-words do not change: **hus → hus**; **vi**, **dere**, **de**
points.U07: An adjective adds **-t** with an et-word: **en fin bil**, **et fint hus**; **veldig**, **også**
points.U08: **står**, **ligger** and **er** for where; **i**, **på**, **under**; **her**, **der**; **det er** for there is
points.U09: **være** for feelings: **jeg er trøtt**, **jeg er sulten**, **jeg er tørst**, **jeg er kald**
points.U33: **Jeg leter etter ordet…**; **det er en ting å…**; **jeg vet ikke**
points.U12: Numbers one to ten; **hvor mange** for how many; **… år** for an age
points.U13: A colour after **er**: **bilen er rød**; before a noun it adds **-t**: **et rødt hus**; **farge**
points.U14: Time words: **i dag**, **i morgen**, **nå**; days take no capital; **Hva er klokka?**
points.U15: **gå** for going: **jeg går**, **du går**, **vi går**; **til** for to a place
points.U52: **Jeg liker å svømme**: **like å** and a verb; **spille fotball**
points.U51: **Hun har blå øyne**: **ha** for features; **lang**, **kort** add **-t** with an et-word
